description: Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 soldered straight onto the board on its male headers (no sockets)
TP4057 USB-C Li-ion charger module with protection, 12.1 x 17 mm, soldered on header stubs
TPS63020 buck-boost module, 1.8-5.5 V in, 3.3 V out, 17.6 x 26.3 mm, soldered on header stubs
JST S2B-PH-K-S, 2-pin PH 2.0 mm side-entry socket (Li-ion cell plug)
3.5 mm stereo jack, right angle PCB mount, 5 pins (PJ-307C) for TRS MIDI
6N138 darlington optocoupler, DIP-8, in a socket (MIDI in)
SPDT slide switch, right angle (bent pins), 4.8 mm pitch, 12.7 x 6.2 x 6.5 body, 6 mm handle (SS12D10G6-WJ)
6 mm tactile button, 13 mm tall round stem (user button through a flat lid)
1N4148 small signal diode, DO-35, lying flat on 7.62 mm (MIDI in reverse protection)
3 mm LED, green (BLE status)
100 kOhm 1/4 W resistor, flat (battery-sense divider)
10 Ohm 1/4 W resistor, flat (MIDI out source side)
33 Ohm 1/4 W resistor, flat (MIDI out data side)
1 kOhm 1/4 W resistor, flat (LED series)
220 Ohm 1/4 W resistor, flat (MIDI in LED series)
M3 mounting hole
EEMB LP553454 Li-Po cell, 3.7 V 1050 mAh, 54x34x5 mm, JST-PH 2.0 plug, built-in protection (PCM)
1x2 2.54 mm pin header (footswitch leads)
DIP-8 IC socket, 7.62 mm
M3 x 20 mm pan head screw (receiver lid through the boss and PCB into the base standoff)
